recommendation: Keep this source fix. It restores the Published FHIR-33032 decision on active ConceptMap source without editing unrelated ConceptMap property types or generated diagram artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-33032 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding Id to ConceptMap dependsOn/product values because FHIR-28284 introduced choice-typed values but omitted ids needed for SNOMED CT descriptionId use cases.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-33032. Related FHIR-28284 history and comments show the choice-type work was applied, and a later ConceptMap2-to-ConceptMap commit included id in the older dependsOn/product value surfaces.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini, the $translate OperationDefinition is listed in source/conceptmap/list-ConceptMap-operations.xml, and the ConceptMap attribute-type CodeSystem is complete and bound to ConceptMap.additionalAttribute.type. FHIR-39151 later refactored ConceptMap property/additionalAttribute definitions and left the current additionalAttribute/dependsOn value type list without id.
reconciliation: Added id to ConceptMap.additionalAttribute.type documentation and CodeSystem, to ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn.value[x] so product inherits it through contentReference, and to $translate dependency.value and match.product.value allowedType lists.
source_changes: source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml: added id to ConceptMap.additionalAttribute.type short text and ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn.value[x] types; product inherits via contentReference.
source/conceptmap/codesystem-conceptmap-attribute-type.xml: added the id concept to the complete ConceptMap attribute-type CodeSystem.
source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml: added id to $translate dependency.value and match.product.value allowedType lists.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the dependsOn/product choice-type model that FHIR-33032 amended by adding id.
Later ConceptMap property/additionalAttribute refactor appears to have dropped id from the current dependsOn/product value type surface.
